title: Sourcify - AI-Powered Business Requirements Document Generation
description: Engineered an AI-assisted BRD generation platform that transforms fragmented business information from emails, meeting transcripts, and documents into structured Business Requirements Documents. Designed a multi-source ingestion and document processing pipeline using FastAPI, Sarvam Document AI, and Google Gemini 2.5 Flash, combining document extraction with contextual AI synthesis to automate requirement gathering. Integrated Gmail and Google Drive to streamline business analysts' workflows, with a React-based interface for reviewing, refining, and generating professional BRDs.

title: Real-Time Log Analytics & Observability Platform
description: Developed a distributed, event-driven observability platform that captures and processes streaming application logs through Apache Kafka and Spring Boot. Implemented a real-time log processing pipeline with PostgreSQL for persistent storage and Apache Lucene for full-text search, enabling efficient log retrieval and service-level analysis. Integrated Grafana for operational dashboards and Docker for containerized deployment, demonstrating the design of scalable backend systems and asynchronous data processing workflows.

title: VoltStream - EV Charging Risk Analytics Lakehouse
description: Designed an end-to-end data engineering pipeline that integrates EV charging station and weather datasets to derive actionable insights into charging infrastructure risk. Implemented a Medallion Architecture on Databricks using PySpark and Delta Lake, transforming raw data into curated analytical datasets. Applied Slowly Changing Dimension Type 2 (SCD Type 2) to preserve historical changes and developed business-ready analytics for downstream visualization and decision-making.
highlights: Historical Data Tracking with SCD Type 2
